decision.summary: Broad asymmetric platform-like deviation in N/E/U from index 520 to 549: N shows gradual rise then plateau, E steady decline then sustained depression, U modest correlated dip; no clear opposing return within allowed context (485–585), so status is uncertain.

intervals.observation: N rises gradually from ~520, flattens near +1 MAD by ~530 and holds until ~549; E dips steadily from ~520 to ~−3 MAD by ~535 and remains depressed through 549; U shows a modest correlated dip peaking ~535. No opposing return observed within allowed context (485–585); recovery not seen before index 550.
